papers.title: A novel low-modulus titanium alloy for biomedical applications: A comparison between selective laser melting and metal injection moulding
papers.first_author_affiliation: National Metal and Materials Technology Center, National Sciences and Technology Development Agency, 114 Thailand Science Park, Klong Luang, Pathumthani, 12120, Thailand

corresponding_authors.name: Anchalee Manonukul
corresponding_authors.affiliation: National Metal and Materials Technology Center, National Sciences and Technology Development Agency, 114 Thailand Science Park, Klong Luang, Pathumthani, 12120, Thailand

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究低模量钛合金用于生物医学植入物，与用户关注的低模量设计以减轻应力遮挡高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: It does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or report fatigue behavior and osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发低模量钛合金以减少植入物应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 对比选区激光熔化和金属注射成型制备该合金。
summary_zh.result: SLM制备的合金具有更优的力学性能匹配和微观结构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、压缩和显微硬度测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a low-modulus titanium alloy for biomedical implants to mitigate stress shielding.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM) and metal injection moulding (MIM) for comparison.
summary_en.result: The SLM-processed alloy exhibited better mechanical property matching and refined microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile, compression, and microhardness tests.

papers.title: Keyhole mode induced simultaneous improvement in strength and ductility of Sc modified Al–Mn alloy manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of Metal High Performance Additive Manufacturing and Innovative Design, MIIT China, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, Shaanxi, 710072, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xin Lin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Metal High Performance Additive Manufacturing and Innovative Design, MIIT China, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, Shaanxi, 710072, China

corresponding_authors.name: Nan Kang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Metal High Performance Additive Manufacturing and Innovative Design, MIIT China, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, Shaanxi, 710072, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Sc改性Al-Mn合金的选区激光熔化工艺，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure analysis, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or implant-related validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善SLM制备Al-Mn-Sc合金的强度-延性权衡。
summary_zh.method: 采用锁孔模式激光熔化工艺优化熔池热历史。
summary_zh.result: 同时提高了合金的强度和延性。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸测试和显微组织表征验证性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in Sc-modified Al-Mn alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The authors employed keyhole-mode laser melting to modify the thermal history and melt pool dynamics.
summary_en.result: Simultaneous improvement in tensile strength and ductility was achieved compared to conventional conduction-mode processing.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical property enhancement was validated through tensile testing and microstructural analysis.
